name: Clare Tuttleby
title: Psychologist
description: Clare's approach integrates evidence-based therapeutic approaches, including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), schema-informed techniques, and mindfulness-based practices. She works with anxiety, mood-related concerns, perinatal mental health, grief and loss related to infertility and reproductive health treatments, pelvic and chronic health conditions.
specialties: Schema Informed Therapy, ACT, Perinatal, Infertility, Burnout

name: Dr Maddie Brygel
title: Psychologist & Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: I am a Melbourne-based psychologist, with a doctorate in both clinical and forensic psychology. I work with people experiencing a range of emotional, psychological and life challenges, including mood difficulties, relationship concerns, grief and addiction. Clinical interests include trauma and PTSD; modalities include Schema Therapy, CBT, ACT and DBT.
specialties: Trauma and PTSD, Schema Therapy, Health professionals, Grief, Addictive behaviours

name: Elizabeth White
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Working days: Wednesdays and Thursdays in Prahran. Trained in experiential and relational psychotherapies including ISTDP and ANZAP's Conversational Model, plus ACT and CBT. Particular interest in chronic depression and physical symptoms related to emotional stress; clinical interests include complex trauma.
specialties: Complex Trauma, Chronic Depression, Grief and Loss, ISTDP

name: Dr Joshua Kugel
title: Psychologist
description: Josh offers an environment where clients feel deeply heard and accepted; where it becomes possible to reconnect with parts of themselves that may have long been forgotten or buried. Josh has worked in both public and private sectors, and has experience with trauma, neurodiversity, depression, anxiety, OCD, grief and loss, perfectionism, and personality disorders.
specialties: Trauma, Existential concerns, Psychedelic integration, OCD, Depression

name: Karen Pereira-York
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Karen is a clinical psychologist with over 30 years of experience who works from a psychodynamic understanding of the person. She works with unpacking trauma, managing anxiety, or understanding the intricacies of relationships, and has worked extensively with sexual abuse trauma. She often uses EMDR to address past wounds, particularly those shaped by relational and complex trauma.
specialties: Complex trauma, Sexual abuse trauma, EMDR, Grief and loss, Migration, Perinatal

name: Kiira Gavralas
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: My work is predominantly informed by psychodynamic, relational, and emotion-focused frameworks, mostly drawing from Intensive Short-Term Dynamic Psychotherapy and models grounded in attachment theory. This way of working can be helpful for emotional difficulties including depressive symptoms, anxiety symptoms, trauma symptoms, grief and loss, emotion regulation difficulties and relationship difficulties. Particular interest in the transition to parenthood.
specialties: Trauma, Perinatal / transition to parenthood, ISTDP, Attachment

name: Dr Krista De Castella
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I'm a clinical psychologist and psychedelic-assisted therapist (Wild Mind and MAPS trained), and part of the Clinical Psychedelic Lab at Monash University, where I've worked with MDMA-Assisted Psychotherapy for PTSD. My approach is grounded in Internal Family Systems (IFS-trained) and informed by psychodynamic, humanistic, and attachment-based frameworks. Clinical interests include LGBTQIA+, non-monogamy/polyamory, sexual problems and sexuality & gender.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Sexuality & Gender, Sexual Problems, Non-Monogamy/Polyamory, PTSD, IFS, Psychedelic integration, Autism
